LL Dance Studio er en danseskole i Ulstr: LL Dance Studio is a dance school in Ulstrup with showdance for all ages – from the youngest on Mini Cuties to elite teams competing at the Danish Championships. Our elite teams admit by audition. Teaching is led by Line Lund Olesen, with 15 years' experience as a dancer and 10 as a teacher, together with a team of skilled trainers.
Vores produkter sælges efter først-til-m: Products are sold first come, first served. Items are handed out at the next training. Sold-out items can be requested by e-mail.
Du er altid velkommen til at kontakte os: You are always welcome to contact us – whether you want to join one of our teams, have questions about the programmes or just want to know more.
Sådan bliver du medlem: find dit hold un: How to become a member: find your team under Timetable, read about it, and sign up in the app – Line approves your profile, usually the same day.
Prisen er en samlet sæsonpakke, der dækk: The price is one season package covering all mandatory training, clothing and props plus automatic entry to upcoming competitions. No hidden fees. Each team's price is on its page.
Beløbet kan betales samlet eller i rater: The amount can be paid in full or in instalments: 2 (half-yearly), 4 (quarterly) or 10 (monthly). Instalments add DKK 50 per instalment.
Når flere i familien danser hos os, beta: When several family members dance with us, the most expensive team is paid in full and every further team gets a 10% discount. Contact us and we will set it up.
Alle dansere får 2 gratis prøvetimer, fø: All dancers get 2 free trial lessons before committing (not elite teams). There is a 14-day right of cancellation from the sign-up date; it lapses once lessons beyond the trials have been used, or if the dancer chooses to stop mid-season. If we close a team or move you to another, the commitment ends and the rest of the period is refunded.
Vores produkter sælges efter først-til-m: Products are sold first come, first served and handed out at the next training. Order and pay in the app (MobilePay) – sold-out items can be requested by e-mail.
